headword: {活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}

definitions.gloss: activity tracker; fitness tracker; activity monitor
definitions.explanation: A wearable electronic device that tracks physical activity metrics such as steps, calories burned, heart rate, and sleep patterns.

examples.japanese: {活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}をつけて{走|はし}っている。
examples.english: I run wearing an activity tracker.

examples.japanese: {活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}で{毎日|まいにち}の{歩数|ほすう}を{確認|かくにん}している。
examples.english: I check my daily step count on the activity tracker.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}のために{活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}を{購入|こうにゅう}したが、{睡眠|すいみん}の{質|しつ}まで{測定|そくてい}できるので{驚|おどろ}いた。
examples.english: I bought an activity tracker for health management, and was surprised it can even measure sleep quality.

notes:
Composed of {活動量|かつどうりょう} (amount of activity) + {計|けい} (meter, gauge). The Japanese term specifically emphasizes measuring the quantity of physical activity. In practice, this overlaps heavily with スマートウォッチ (smartwatch) and フィットネストラッカー (fitness tracker).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}をつける: to wear an activity tracker
- {活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}で{計測|けいそく}する: to measure with an activity tracker
- {腕時計型|うでどけいがた}{活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}: wristwatch-type activity tracker
- {活動量計|かつどうりょうけい}のデータ: activity tracker data

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {万歩計|まんぽけい}: pedometer — a simpler device that counts only steps
- スマートウォッチ: smartwatch — a more advanced device with many features beyond activity tracking
- フィットネストラッカー: fitness tracker — the English loanword equivalent
